theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.

top_news.title: Why Earnings Growth Remain a Key Buffer Against Yield Risks
top_news.summary: Capital.com Senior Market Analyst Kyle Rodda argues that strong corporate earnings continue to buffer equities against rising bond yields and AI valuation risks. He also cautions that investor tolerance could fade quickly if profit growth expectations begin to fade. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Citi Recommends Buying China’s 30-Year Bonds on Weak Growth
top_news.summary: Citigroup Inc. is advising investors to buy 30-year Chinese government bonds as it expects lingering weakness in the economy and tapering supply of longer-term debt to boost demand for the paper.

top_news.title: Flashlight Capital Urges Secom to Raise Stake in Korea’s S-1
top_news.summary: Activist investor Flashlight Capital Partners urged Japan’s Secom Co. to roughly double its interest in South Korea’s S-1 Corp. and Taiwan Secom Co., roping in a new party after its earlier bid to acquire an S-1 stake was rejected.

top_news.title: Samsung to Invest $1 Billion in KKR’s AI Infrastructure Company
top_news.summary: Samsung Group companies including Samsung Electronics Co. agreed to invest a combined $1 billion in Helix Digital Infrastructure, a KKR & Co.-backed US company, deepening the South Korean conglomerate’s push into the rapidly expanding artificial-intelligence infrastructure market.

top_news.title: Tax-Slashing ‘Holy Grail’ Popularized by AQR Dealt IRS Warning
top_news.summary: A strategy popularized by AQR Capital Management, the world’s largest hedge fund, to help wealthy people slash their taxes on ordinary income is facing the most concrete sign yet that US authorities are preparing to clamp down.

top_news.title: UK Should Relax Accounting Rules to Boost Investment, Paper Says
top_news.summary: Britain is wasting an opportunity to invest billions of pounds in infrastructure by sticking to rigid national accounting rules that prevent arms-length government bodies from borrowing on their own account, the Common Wealth think tank said.

top_news.title: Subprime Auto Loans Make Wall Street Rich as Borrowers Struggle
top_news.summary: Data show lenders used different tactics, extending terms or repossessing cars quickly, to keep their investors happy. Neither approach is great for customers. Paige Smith and Ann Choi report. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek Says Company Needs a 'Growth Engine'
top_news.summary:
Former Walt Disney CEO Bob Chapek says the firm needs a 'growth engine' while speaking during an interview on Bloomberg Businessweek Daily. Chapek also says that Disney employees have been discouraged from keeping in contact with him and that he hasn't heard from CEO Josh D'Amaro since 2022.

top_news.title: Korean Financial Firms Chase Bold Overseas M&A to Fuel Growth
top_news.summary: South Korean banks and insurers are hunting for overseas deals to lift growth, signaling a broader outward turn by an industry that largely stayed home while companies including Samsung Electronics Co. and Hyundai Motor Co. built global businesses.

top_news.title: Copper Set to Give Australia’s Mining Stock Rally a New Engine
top_news.summary: Australia’s mining stocks are poised to extend their rally, analysts say, as surging copper demand for power infrastructure and artificial intelligence gives investors a new reason to buy the sector.
